models.description: Seven MTP GGUF tiers plus vision projector for ScarletKc-2.0: a byte-identical 448-tensor NVFP4 backbone across all tiers with a per-tier precision ladder for lm_head, token embedding, and MTP head. MTP speculative decoding baked into every file. Blackwell sm_120.
